place.description: Free text, e.g. a bar's name. Shown publicly, so keep it general.

where.description: venue = at the game in person; counts toward games attended.

subject.description: The com.professorbutts.sports.game or leaderboard record. A uri, not a strongRef, because game records are rewritten in place.

rootingFor.description: A com.professorbutts.sports.team (or person) record. Leave out for neutral.

subjectCid.description: Optional: the version the fan saw, for display/audit only.

description: A fan saying they're watching (or went to) a game or event, kept in the fan's own repo. One per fan per event: the record key is the subject's record key, so writing again replaces it (update in place to change who they're rooting for). Older records may use a TID key.
